character: white farm duck, angry payer talking to the lens; fills two thirds of the frame height in every window
cast: duckling intern in a tie, only 4.4-5.8: holds his toy terminal to her tear, never speaks
motion_rule: no window ends in a pose: its last frame is already the first of the next move; long windows carry two moves in opposite directions
camera_moves: one take; each window's camera move must happen there; never held still, never the same size twice
props: terminal on a garden stump; receipt tape from the slot; cord on her left leg, always visible; his toy terminal, gone with him
environment: village pond at noon, direct sun, hard shadows; the background never stands still, never over a third of the frame

audio.delivery: female voice from the duck, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: плачу at 1.4 is pla-CHU, paying money; плачу at 3.9 is PLA-chu, weeping, never pla-CHU
audio.pacing: one continuous phrase 0.5 to 6.7, no breath at any join; after 6.7 no word at all

timeline.a: she slams both wings on the terminal, it skids across the stump
timeline.c: close on it, rips up to her face

timeline.a: 0.5-0.9 she bites the tape and rips it out of the slot; 0.9-1.4 she hauls it, backing away, the tape unreeling
timeline.c: tracks back, the pond slides across

timeline.a: she snaps back, the tape whips the full width of the frame, the cord goes taut
2.1-2.6 she hauls the cord and hoists the knotted leg over her head; 2.6-3.2 she rises onto the stump on the free leg, the hoisted leg swinging the cord in a full circle
she drags a wing down her face crown to beak and past her chest, doubling over
her chest heaves in one sob, her head throws back, a fat tear jumps off the beak
the duckling shoves his toy terminal under her beak, she rears her body back
she sweeps a wing through, he rolls out past the frame edge, she carries the swing round
timeline.c: swings out after him and back

timeline.a: 5.8-6.2 she stamps both feet on the terminal, the tape jumping; 6.2-6.7 she stamps faster, it slides to the stump edge
timeline.c: low at stump level, kicked by each stamp

timeline.a: she throws her chest down on the stump, wings flung up, the roped leg kicked out
7.3-7.6 her head snaps up, the tear flies off the beak; 7.6-8.0 she swings the head round to the terminal, it flashes a green tick
8.0-8.4 she braces both feet on the stump and throws her body back; 8.4-8.8 she hauls on, sliding back through the grass
timeline.c: tracks back, the village slides out

timeline.a: she drags the terminal off the stump, it swings down on the cord above the grass
she rolls onto her back and hauls the terminal at the lens, tape trailing, her body filling the frame

must_appear: green tick right after her tear; her roped left leg in every window
negative_prompt: cyrillic, subtitles, dark scene, slow motion, any Russian word outside the lines, speech after 6.7, the duckling speaking, male voice, extra legs, extra wings, props moving untouched, a second adult duck, the duckling in frame after 5.8, a locked camera, the duck small against the scenery, a pose held to the end of a window, a move played out early, both плачу said with the same stress, the terminal still on the stump after 9.4
